An '''individual''' served as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /><ref name="Turkana date">The ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' had Lennox commanding the [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']] during the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]]. As the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] made use of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] during the battle, it must occur after the Rebel's [[Fresian campaign|campaign]] to obtain the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], which occurred in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. In [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], the Battle of Turkana occurred at the start of the game, with the end of the second tour of duty focusing on the Alliance obtaining the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]]. Those missions occurred shortly after the [[Battle of Kattada]], which took place in 35:2 GrS&mdash;or 1 BBY&mdash;by its concurrence with the [[Subjugation of Ralltiir]] and that battle's dating in ''[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]''. From this information, it can be determined that the Battle of Turkana occurred in 1 BBY.</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the governor ordered [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Xamuel Lennox]] to lead ten [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] in an attack against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Turkana/Legends|Turkana]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />
